entities.name: Heart of Frost
entities.description: Mountain in the Tendo Peaks of the Sokenzan range on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: Traveled to the Heart of Frost and summoned Yuki-Onna with kanji in blood.

entities.name: Yuki-Onna
entities.description: Dangerous spirit of the freezing mountain slope.

entities.name: Kiku
entities.description: Led Uramon's hatchet men; bonded with Toshi by kanji.

entities.name: Marrow-Gnawer
entities.description: Nezumi leader who bonded with Toshi by kanji.

entities.name: Boss Uramon
entities.description: Crime boss whose hatchet men hunted Toshi.

entities.name: Uchida
entities.description: Killed by Yuki-Onna before the summit.

entities.name: Hyozan Reckoners
entities.description: Kanji that blasted Yuki-Onna back into the spirit realm.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which the events took place.

events.summary: Toshi inscribed Yuki-Onna's kanji near the summit, and she killed Uchida and half the party.
events.quote: In this way, she killed Uchida and half of the party even before they reached the summit

events.summary: Toshi, Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer inscribed the Hyozan Reckoners kanji, blasting Yuki-Onna away and forming blood-bonds.

relations.quote: to stop Kiku , Marrow-Gnawer , and a gang of Uramon 's hatchet men from catching him
